items.title: UNC downs UConn, 38-21
items.summary: The UNC Tar Heels (5-4) capitalized on the UConn Huskies’ (4-5) worst turnover day of the season to win 38-21. Quarterback Kalieb Osborne completed 17 of 35 (48.6%) passes for 245 yards, two touchdowns, two interceptions, and a fumble. items.title: Huskies Lose Battle With Tar Heels
items.summary: EAST HARTFORD, CT – The North Carolina Tar Heels created three turnovers leading to 21 points on the way to a 38-21 win over the UConn Huskies Saturday afternoon in front of 36,901 at Pratt & Whitney Stadium at Rentschler Field.

items.title: Air Force Runs Past Huskies
items.summary: COLORADO SPRINGS, CO – The Air Force Falcons ran for 366 yards on the way to a 35-26 win over the visting UConn Huskies Saturday afternoon in front of 20,062 at Falcon Stadium.

items.title: Huskies Roll Past UMass
items.summary: EAST HARTFORD, CT – The UConn Huskies ran for 265 yards behind running back Cyncir Bowers who notched his second 100-yard game of the season on the way to a 35-16 win over the UMass Minutemen Friday night in front of 32,106 at Pratt & Whitney Stadium at Rentschler Field.
